name: Weekly Cleaning Checklist
description: A once-a-week cleaning routine organized room by room to keep your home consistently tidy.

items.text: Wipe down and disinfect all countertops and the backsplash
Clean the stovetop, microwave interior, and small appliance fronts
Scrub the sink, run the disposal, and polish the faucet
Wipe cabinet handles, the fridge door, and light switches
Empty the trash and recycling and disinfect the bins
Sweep and mop the floor
Scrub and disinfect the toilet, including the base and behind the bowl
Clean the shower, tub, and glass door
Wipe down the vanity, sink, and faucet
Polish the mirror and clear water spots
Swap in fresh towels and bath mats
items.note: Keep two sets of towels in rotation so swaps are effortless.

items.text: Sweep and mop the floor
Strip the beds and wash sheets and pillowcases
Remake the beds with fresh linens
Dust nightstands, dressers, and shelves
Wipe down light switches, handles, and remotes
Vacuum the floor, including under the bed
Dust shelves, electronics, and decor from top to bottom
Wipe down the coffee table, side tables, and remotes
Fluff cushions and fold blankets
Clean glass surfaces, mirrors, and TV screens
Vacuum upholstery and under cushions
Vacuum or mop the floors
Vacuum all carpets and rugs throughout the home
Sweep and mop every hard floor
Vacuum stairs and wipe down railings
Dust along visible baseboards and window sills
Spot-clean fingerprints from doors and frames
Wash, dry, fold, and put away all laundry
Wipe down the washer and dryer exteriors and clear the lint trap
Collect and take out all trash and recycling
Replace any empty soap, paper, or supply refills
Do a final walkthrough to catch anything missed

faq.a: Vacuuming and mopping floors, dusting surfaces, changing bed linens, cleaning bathrooms, and wiping down the kitchen are all weekly tasks. This checklist organizes them by room.

faq.q: How long should a weekly clean take?
faq.a: A weekly clean usually takes one to two hours for an average home. Splitting it across two shorter sessions or between household members makes it faster.

faq.q: What is the best day to do a weekly clean?
faq.a: Pick whichever day fits your schedule and stick to it. Many people choose a weekend morning or a weekday evening so the home stays fresh for the days ahead.

faq.q: How is a weekly clean different from a deep clean?
faq.a: A weekly clean maintains visible surfaces and floors on a regular cadence. A deep clean tackles hidden buildup like grout and behind appliances every few months.

faq.q: Can I download this weekly cleaning checklist?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or save the PDF, then check off each room every week as part of your routine.
